name: aethervfs
description: Windows virtual filesystem: compose a process's view of the disk from pluggable providers

scripts.bench: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build.mts --release && node bench/run.mts
scripts.bench:ab: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build.mts --release && node bench/ab-js-layer.mts
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/build.mts && node scripts/check-types.mts && tsc --noEmit && node examples/vertical-slice.cts && node examples/js-provider.cts && node examples/spec-8-example.cts && vitest run
